skills.name: hausfold-docs-search
skills.description: Search and read the hausfold manuals (haus, pounce, perch, scruff, trill) as text. Use when a question about a haus.* option, a keyboard shortcut, an install step, or any behaviour of these Mac tools needs an authoritative answer.

skills.name: hausfold-install
skills.description: Install a haus desktop (hacker, everyday, minimal) on a macOS machine with one shell command. Use when the user wants their Mac rebuilt from a config file, wants one of the named desktops, or asks how to try haus.

skills.name: hausfold-releases
skills.description: Check the latest signed macOS release of a hausfold app (pounce, perch) and get its direct download URL. Use before naming a version, checking for updates, or linking a download.
